Data behind the deliveries

The 2024 survey asked residents whether food, groceries or packages arrived at home. The charts show the weighted share of valid survey days reporting at least one delivery of each type. A day can include more than one type.

The equipment figures come from commercial-bicycle business inspections in 2013–2021. Each percentage shows how often an equipment issue was recorded among eligible inspections. The same business can appear more than once.
